data.body: Document-critique / plan-review model research (context only, no revisions). The reframe from "plan review" to "critical document evaluation" worked, but the payoff was NOT peer review - that seam is nearly empty for model selection (PRISM benchmarks reviewer SYSTEMS on Llama/Qwen backbones, not frontier models). The find is RUBRIC VERIFICATION: RuVerBench arXiv:2606.29920, 2458 human-labelled instances, Cohen kappa 0.808, task is literally ours - given an artifact and a rubric criterion, emit satisfied/not-satisfied. Scored in Balanced Accuracy, so negative recall is half the score and false positives are penalised symmetrically. KEY RESULTS. (1) The 14-position ranking-instability finding REPRODUCES INSIDE ONE PAPER: same metric, same prompt, rankings reorder by up to 5 positions between Deep Research and Agentic Coding domains. (2) Claude Opus 4.7 is the ONLY model that does not move - #3 in both (91.7 / 85.0). (3) Precision finding that outranks the scores: GPT-5.4 tops Agentic Coding BAcc but the paper says it "frequently turn[s] optional or untriggered conditions into requirements" - the exact failure that makes a gate useless. (4) UXBench human evaluation REVERSES its own automated ranking: Claude Sonnet 4.6 first on all 7 human dimensions while Kimi K2.5 drops from #2 automated to #6 human; Gemini-3.1-Pro is #1 on RuVerBench Deep Research and LAST on UXBench. (5) MOST OPERATIONALLY IMPORTANT - Kahneman4Review arXiv:2607.10511 measured judge reliability: cross-VERSION sonnet-3.7 vs sonnet-4-6 gives kappa 0.14 at 33% exact agreement, while cross-VENDOR claude vs gpt-4o gives kappa 0.58. A model version bump changes gate verdicts MORE than swapping vendors. Pin judge model ids and re-baseline on every upgrade. (6) Ticket/issue quality critique: NO head-to-head frontier-model comparison exists; Atlassian benchmarks page 404s; nothing from Linear or GitHub. That domain must be measured in-house. (7) SpecBench arXiv:2605.30314 is the closest task shape but its metric ignores false positives entirely and all per-model numbers are figures - unusable for ranking; useful only as a level-set that nothing exceeds 45% at finding specification deficiencies. (8) Prompt phrasing moves Overall by up to +11.8 points - worth more than model choice at the margin. (9) Fable 5 returns stop_reason "refusal" as HTTP 200, a correctness hazard for an automated gate. RECOMMENDATION from the agent: one model for both roles, Claude Opus 5 with Sonnet 5 as cost tier - chosen on STABILITY across independent streams rather than peak score, with the explicit caveat that Opus 5 has ZERO document-critique coverage and the family-property assumption is exactly what the kappa 0.14 result undermines.
